# Shear Style by Amanda

> San Diego hairstylist in Point Loma / Rosecrans — precision cuts, color, and calming appointments.

Shear Style by Amanda is the hair business of Amanda, a San Diego hairstylist who works inside Surface Studio in Point Loma. She focuses on precision haircuts, lived-in color, and smoothing treatments, with a listening-first, calm, personalized approach.

## Key facts
- Address: Surface Studio, 1255 Rosecrans Street, San Diego, CA 92106
- Phone: (619) 857-1545
- Email: shearstylebyamanda@gmail.com
- Book online (Vagaro): https://mysite.vagaro.com/shearstylebyamanda/book-now
- Gift cards (Vagaro): https://mysite.vagaro.com/shearstylebyamanda/gift-certificates
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/shearstylebyamanda (studio: https://instagram.com/surfacestudio.sd)
- Walk-ins welcome. Free parking. Beer & wine. WiFi. Kid friendly. English.
- Payments: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Debit, Cash.
- Cancellation: Please allow 48 hours’ notice for all cancellations. Cancel within 48 hours and pay 50% of the service amount scheduled. Cancel within 24 hours or no-show and pay 100% of the service amount scheduled.
